reviewNotes: Descriptions starting with 'CHECK:' describe code behaviour that may not be intended, or a judgment call. Confirm or correct each, then set reviewed to true.

Task order (immediate session): welcome; microphone check if Spoken; learning trial 1 (Instructions 01, words, Instructions 05, recall); learning trials 2..N (Instructions 02, words, recall); if List B: Instructions 03, List B words, recall of B, then Instructions 04 and recall of List A again without re-presenting it; notes; thank you. A delayed session (Delayed recall = Yes) skips all presentation: delayed instructions, then recall of List A.
Possible bugs in existing sets, found while writing this (not changed):

- 9 FaCE/Demo sets use Word list EN_FaCE_Training, EN_FaCE_VerB or EN_Demo. The page looks up <LANG>_<Word list>, i.e. EN_EN_FaCE_Training, which doesn't exist, and there is no matching audio folder. These values are kept as pull-down options marked CHECK so the sets still open.
- RAVLT_Manual_Delayed has Delayed recall = No and no Audio/Visual presentation setting, so it would present no words before recall. It probably needs Delayed recall = Yes, like RAVLT_Spoken_Delayed.
- FaCE_Immediate_Spoken_VerA_EN has Recall type = Manual despite 'Spoken' in its name.
- DemoENManual has Instructions01Time = 10 (a single number; the code expects a list of milliseconds). Harmless while Speak the instructions is No.

DelayedRecallFlag.title: Delayed recall session
DelayedRecallFlag.description: Yes: this is the delayed-recall part. No words are presented; the participant sees the delayed-recall instructions and recalls List A once. All presentation settings below are then ignored. No: an immediate session with learning trials.

WordList.title: Word list
WordList.description: Which words are used. The page loads the list named <language>_<Word list> from InstructionsAndStimuli/Stimuli/WordRecall_Lists.js, and the audio from assets/SoundFiles/Words/<Word list>/<language>/<Audio folder>.

FolderName.title: Audio folder (voice)
FolderName.description: Subfolder of the word list's audio holding one recording per word, so a different voice can be used without changing the list. Every list currently has only 'Set001/'. Keep the trailing slash.

FileExtension.title: Audio file extension
FileExtension.description: Extension of the word audio files, including the dot. All existing word audio is .wav.

NBlocks.title: Learning trials
NBlocks.description: How many times List A is presented and recalled in an immediate session (RAVLT standard: 5). Ignored in a delayed session.

AudioPresentation.title: Speak the words
AudioPresentation.description: Play each word's audio. If Show the words is also Yes, the word is shown on screen while it plays. CHECK: if both this and Show the words are No, no words are presented at all.

VisualPresentation.title: Show the words
VisualPresentation.description: Show each word on screen. With Speak the words = No, the words are shown silently. CHECK: List B is only ever presented as audio, so a visual-only session with List B shows no List B words.

TimePerWord.title: Time per word (ms)
TimePerWord.description: How long each word is presented. A 200 ms fixation cross comes before each word (fixed in config/WordRecall_Setup.js). With audio, allow enough time for the recording to finish (existing audio sets use 500-1500 ms).

BListFlag.title: Include List B (interference list)
BListFlag.description: After the learning trials: present List B once and recall it, then ask for List A again without re-presenting it (the standard RAVLT interference and short-delay recall).

WordListOrder.title: Word order
WordListOrder.description: Optional. Positions of the words in the list, starting at 0. Leave empty to present the words in list order every trial.

anyOf.title: Different order for each learning trial
Same order for every learning trial

oneOf.title: Spoken: the participant says the words; recorded, with speech recognition (microphone check first)

RecallDuration.title: Recall time (s)
RecallDuration.description: How long each recall period lasts. The countdown clock starts at this value.

DelayBeforeShowingDoneButton.title: Seconds before the Done button appears
DelayBeforeShowingDoneButton.description: The participant can end a recall period early once this many seconds have passed. Must be less than Recall time. CHECK: if this is missing, the Done button never appears and recall always runs the full time.
